question: In humans, what are the pharmacokinetics of emicizumab and their association with efficacy in haemophilia A?
eligibility: The study concerns emicizumab (or its development names ACE910 / factor VIII-mimetic bispecific antibody).
Conducted in humans (persons with haemophilia A, including healthy-volunteer bridging studies).
Reports pharmacokinetics/exposure and/or associated efficacy (bleeding-rate) data.
A clinical trial, pharmacokinetic, or pharmacometric study.
as_of_source: day after the latest Entrez date among gold records (a lower bound on the review's search date)
source: SYNERGY dataset Donners_2021; 'Pharmacokinetics and Associated Efficacy of Emicizumab in Humans' (Clin Pharmacokinet 2021, doi:10.1007/s40262-021-01042-w); gold = label_included==1 rows with DOI via [AID]
notes: Converted from the protocol-first branch. naive_blocks come from protocols written by the fixture author, some tightened while looking at the gold set, so the naive floor may be optimistic.
